summary: The ideal Graves, ignoring cost. Her damage has four sources, and this build multiplies all of them: the gun (Titanic Magazine, Recharging Rush, Hollow Point, Swift Striker, Spiritual Overflow, Spellslinger), Grasping Hands and the ultimate (cooldown reduction through the whole Compress-Superior-Transcendent chain, spirit power through Boundless Spirit and Overflow), the Jar of Dead summons (Rapid Recharge gives +2 charges, Recharging Rush refills them) and the debuffs (Escalating Exposure on spirit hits, Ballistic Enchantment feeding the gun from Hands hits). Counterspell keeps her alive. Every chain is finished and every imbue is set. It needs a very long game. Survivability: Graves has 730 base health and no escape, but she shoots from long range and her ghouls and deadheads draw the focus, so she can run lean. This build keeps one defensive slot (Counterspell: 150 health and a spell parry) plus health and lifesteal from Boundless Spirit and Spiritual Overflow. If your team peels for you, swap Counterspell for Glass Cannon (60% weapon damage, fire rate per kill): the kit can support a glass cannon, and the swap table shows it.
